assumptions.weighting: One positive constant in original corrected-flux units per target-sector observation.
assumptions.limitations: Adjacent differences assume locally independent comparable scatter; correlated noise can bias low and rapid variability high. Frozen detrending still applies observed-scatter floors. Empirical errors are not producer errors or a survey false-alarm calibration.

interpretation: Alternative uncertainty-assumption search, separate from frozen producer-error main analysis. No candidate validation or discovery claim.
